Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect, part of Strand 7 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to show when something happened? 2. How do we tell an action is or was happening?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: This is promoted as the learner confidently uses present and past continuous forms in sentences correctly.

• Learning to Learn: It is developed as the learner identifies present and past continuous forms from newspaper and

magazine articles.

Values

• Responsibility is cultivated as the learner takes up roles during role play and simulation activities with peers.

• Integrity: It is enhanced as the learner observes honesty when searching for information in newspaper or magazines
